annotations.title: Create a document from a recording

description: Turns a screen recording into documentation: Easy Scribe writes numbered steps with a screenshot at each one, from what happens on screen and any narration, so recordings without audio work too. Takes video_url (a direct link to an .mp4, .webm or .mov file) or upload_path (from create_upload_url). Each call creates a new document in the user's Easy Scribe account, which counts toward the Free plan's monthly allowance; processing takes a few minutes, and get_document reports progress and returns the finished document. When the allowance is used up, it returns an error that says when more documents are available.

description.description: Optional: the audience, purpose or focus the user asked for. Easy Scribe sees the video itself, so this doesn't need to describe what happens in it.

language.description: Language to write in, for example English. Default Auto (the language spoken in the video).

redact_pii.description: Blur personal data in text and screenshots. Requires Easy Scribe Pro.

template.description: Document format. Default general. See list_templates.

title.description: Document title, for example "How to issue a refund".

video_url.description: Direct https link to a video file. Page links (Loom, YouTube) open a web page rather than a video file; such videos are downloaded first and uploaded with create_upload_url.

workspace_id.description: Optional workspace from list_workspaces. Default: personal workspace.
